# Docs

- [Introduction](https://silo.evanyu.dev/docs): What is Silo?
- [Deploying Silo](https://silo.evanyu.dev/docs/deploy): How to deploy Silo to your own infrastructure.
- [Screenshots](https://silo.evanyu.dev/docs/screenshots): Screenshots of the Silo UI
- [SDK Demo](https://silo.evanyu.dev/docs/sdk-demo): SDK Demo for Silo.

- **SDK**
- [Getting Started](https://silo.evanyu.dev/docs/sdk): Get started with the Silo SDK.
- Core
  - [Core](https://silo.evanyu.dev/docs/sdk/core): Framework-agnostic upload, URL, and callback primitives.
  - [URLs and Callbacks](https://silo.evanyu.dev/docs/sdk/core/urls-and-callbacks): Generate file URLs and verify upload callbacks with sdk-core.
  - [API Reference](https://silo.evanyu.dev/docs/sdk/core/api-reference): Generated type tables for the core SDK.
- Server
  - [Server](https://silo.evanyu.dev/docs/sdk/server): Typed file routes, middleware, upload expectations, and callback dispatch.
  - [Router Behavior](https://silo.evanyu.dev/docs/sdk/server/router-behavior): How registration, middleware, and callbacks behave in sdk-server.
  - [API Reference](https://silo.evanyu.dev/docs/sdk/server/api-reference): Generated type tables for the server SDK.
- Next
  - [Next.js](https://silo.evanyu.dev/docs/sdk/next): App Router integration for the Silo upload router.
  - Advanced: Advanced topics for the Next.js SDK.
    - [Completion Store](https://silo.evanyu.dev/docs/sdk/next/advanced/completion-store): How the Next adapter stores onUploadComplete results and how to replace the default store.
  - [API Reference](https://silo.evanyu.dev/docs/sdk/next/api-reference): Generated type tables for the Next.js SDK.
  - [Minimal Next.js SDK Demo](https://silo.evanyu.dev/docs/sdk/next/minimal-sdk-demo): A minimal deployed example of how to use the Next.js SDK.
- React
  - [React](https://silo.evanyu.dev/docs/sdk/react): Typed React hooks for uploads, staged flows, and progress events.
  - [Components](https://silo.evanyu.dev/docs/sdk/react/components): Headless upload components exposed by sdk-react.
  - [API Reference](https://silo.evanyu.dev/docs/sdk/react/api-reference): Generated type tables for the React SDK.
- TanStack Start
  - [TanStack Start](https://silo.evanyu.dev/docs/sdk/tanstack-start): Server route integration for the Silo upload router.
  - [API Reference](https://silo.evanyu.dev/docs/sdk/tanstack-start/api-reference): Generated type tables for the TanStack Start SDK.
